title: A four-way Massey interaction makes counting #P-hard where no pair can be hard
claim: for p >= 5 and G_p = U4(F_p) x| <D>, D = diag(1, -1, 1, -1) (order 2p^6, no graded hard pair; at r = 2 none can exist and every coprime class-2 group is polynomial), on closed 3-manifolds M = S^3_2(K) with H1 = Z/2: |Hom(pi1 M, G_p)| = 1 + p^(N+4) #{c in V^3 : Q_M(c; .) = 0}, V = H^1(M; F_p twisted), Q_M the twisted triple Massey product paired with V through the J-duality of the Fox-coloring transport (Burau at t = -1). Q vanishes on 2-surgeries of sums of knots with one-dimensional V; inserting gamma . cable2(P) . gamma^-1 for a pure braid P with conjugators in the third lower central term adds 2 sum_j Lam_j(c) ell_j(s) (degree-3 Magnus tensor contracted with bundle functionals). The gadget of a loopless multigraph gives |Hom| = 1 + p^(12m+4) Z_f(Gamma) with an integer, even edge weight f, f(0) = p^12, f(0,0,0,1) = p^6 (2p^4 - p^2); W = f^2 is not block-rank-1, so counting is #P-hard (Bulatov-Grohe, edge doubling).
failure_conditions: A letter (n <= 12) whose Fox-coloring transport fails to preserve J or J^T over Z, or a failure of the bundle identity or of J^T 1 = ((-1)^(n-1-q)).

A support pattern whose construction is not a homomorphism from Aff(F_p) into G_p, sends the reflection fixing 0 elsewhere than D, or has a superdiagonal constant that depends on g or vanishes on its support (p = 5, 7, 11, 13).
P4 not pure, a conjugator with nonzero degree-1 or degree-2 Magnus part, a 2-cable not acting by substitution of bundle products, or a cable coloring transport different from the identity over Z.

A count #{(A, B) : Phi_0(A, B, .) = 0} different from 2p^4 - p^2 (p = 5, 7, 11, 13), a non-integral or rescaling-dependent edge weight at p = 5, f(0) != p^12, f(d*) != p^6 (2p^4 - p^2), or a vanishing minor.
A reduced K2 template on which the kernel-rank count differs from p^(-N) Z_f(K2).
Experiment BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001B-E001 not supported (base vanishing, exact steering for P4 and P4B, gadgets on six graphs at p = 5, 7, 11, independent counts and lifting test).
foundation_claim_scope: p >= 5, r = 2 (closed 3-manifolds with H1 = Z/2 given as 2-surgeries on closed braids); hardness under polynomial-time Turing reductions. Cited, not reproved: Bulatov-Grohe as stated in Cai-Chen-Lu Thm 2.1; closed-braid presentations and the Seifert longitude; longitudes lie in the second derived subgroup; meridian amalgams for connected sums; Poincare duality for H^2(M; F_p); CLASSK-DICHOTOMY-20261026-001C for the class-2 side. Not covered: p = 2, 3; r > 2 (channel terms in the base form); knot exteriors; a full class-3 criterion. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: the group and its characters, no graded hard pair; J-invariance of the Fox-coloring transport over Z for every letter and n <= 12, the bundle and constant identities; the eight symmetric-power constructions as homomorphisms on Aff(F_p) into G_p with the stated constants (p = 5, 7, 11, 13); P4 pure, conjugators in the third term over Z, single cabled letters and the whole cable acting by bundle substitution, cable transport the identity; the edge-weight count 2p^4 - p^2 at p = 5, 7, 11, 13 and f on every support pattern at p = 5; the count identity on a reduced K2 template at p = 5 by kernel ranks; experiment BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001B-E001 supported (two independent models and an independent group-law count); no human or external review
